answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant mechanism wherein each node deposits staking collateral $C$ alongside a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function, creating a dynamic opportunity-cost bond that tracks the global economic tide. This commitment is registered on a decentralized atlas of identities, pushing any adversary attempting identity multiplication to a strategic ledge where slashing penalties $S$ are triggered by subgame-perfect matrices. Because expected utility E[U] < 0 for attacks, honest participation converges to a robust Nash equilibrium.
